{{Quote|You're the one sent by Mon Mothma, I take it. Well, I've hurt my leg, so I'll need a little help getting back to base. Lead on.|Altapi T'mman|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Altapi T'mman''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she was involved in a plan to gain the Alliance more secrecy. The operation involved the Alliance sacrificing three of its Corellian Corvettes by masquerading them as an expeditionary force trying to retake [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where they engaged a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. The ships were operating with skeleton crews, and after the battle all their captains were accounted for&mdash;except for T'mman. Her [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] had crashed, and her leg was injured, leaving her unable to make contact with the Alliance. She was rescued and escorted to safety by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StrandedRebelPilotTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Altapi T'mman]]
Altapi T'mman was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as part of the Rebel Themepark quest series. She was removed from the game with the introduction of Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild in [[May]] of [[2007]], when the Rebel Themepark was replaced with a new series of quests.

Due to the nature of many older quests in Star Wars Galaxies, the gender, species, and appearance of T'mman changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the canonical species of T'mman. However, the quest dialogue given by Mon Mothma indicated that Altapi T'mman was a female.
